title: GNUS.ai ELM Model Manifest
description: Dedicated generation source for the ELM model manifest types. The same three definitions live in gnus-processing-schema.json (shape documentation), but quicktype's schema reachability rules drop definitions not referenced from root properties -- this file exists solely so ElmModelManifest and its dependencies regenerate through the same quicktype pipeline (D-05: one pipeline, zero hand edits to generated/)

ElmModelArtifact.description: One artifact of an ELM model bundle. The name is a ROLE from a closed set (never a filesystem path); the runtime materializes each role at MNN's default filename via ElmRuntime RoleFileName

name.description: Artifact role: llm_config, llm_model, llm_weight, tokenizer_file, or context_file

uri.description: URI the artifact is fetched from (production: FileManager loaders only)

sha256.description: sha256 of the artifact bytes, 64 hex characters

size_bytes.description: Exact artifact size in bytes; drives cache LRU accounting and the disk preflight

ElmModelManifest.description: Content-addressed manifest of an ELM model bundle. Its bytes are hash-pinned by the work item's model_manifest_hash before parsing (SC-1). model_format is deliberately a pattern-constrained STRING, not an enum: sgns::ModelFormat is already a live generated enum from model_config.format with in-repo consumers

schema_version.description: Manifest shape version; fixed at 1 (gnus_spec_version style const)

elm_type.description: v1.0 implements causal_lm only (same enum as the Elm work item)

model_format.description: v1.0 mandates MNN. Pattern is documentation-only post-codegen; the C++ semantic gate fail-closes on any value != mnn (MANIFEST_INVALID)

quantization.description: Quantization descriptor (informational metadata only in v1.0)

artifacts.description: Bundle artifacts. Non-empty is enforced by the ElmManifest C++ gate (quicktype drops minItems)

runtime.description: Runtime resource requirements (local capability preflight only)

ElmModelRuntime.description: Runtime resource block of an ELM model manifest. Feeds the local CapabilityValidator preflight (plan 02-02); never advertised on the network

required_memory_bytes.description: Host RAM the loaded model requires; 0/absent = no requirement (the number bound does not survive codegen on optionals -- the C++ gate re-checks >= 0)
